episodes.title: Bangarang
episodes.summary: Intergalactic bounty hunters Dutch and John face their deadliest mission yet as they attempt to save a family member from assassination.

episodes.title: The Sugar Point Run
episodes.summary: A hostage exchange with a vengeful warlord turns deadly when the Killjoys are stranded in a restricted, bombed-out city overrun with dangerous gangs and scavengers.

episodes.title: The Harvest
episodes.summary: A warrant to retrieve a missing migrant worker on Leith isn't as simple as it seems when the Killjoys discover something dangerous lurking beyond the edge of a farm. Meanwhile, a psych exam brings into question whether D'avin is mentally fit to join the RAC.

episodes.title: Vessel
episodes.summary: The Killjoys find their real rhythm as a trio while navigating the ugly side of Qreshi politics as they transport a group of gorgeous Surrogates in a bullet-riddled ride from a badlands fortress.

episodes.title: A Glitch in the System
episodes.summary: An easy salvage job on an abandoned ship takes an insidious turn when the Killjoys discover they are not alone and find themselves having to confront their deepest, darkest secrets.

episodes.title: One Blood
episodes.summary: Top Killjoys from around The Quad are pitted against one another in a race to find Big Joe, a legendary bounty hunter gone rogue.

episodes.title: Kiss Kiss, Bye Bye
episodes.summary: The quest to uncover the mystery behind D'avin's missing memories leads the Killjoys to an underground black market and triggers a shocking incident that will haunt the team.

episodes.title: Come the Rain
episodes.summary: A toxic Black Rain storm over Westerley forces John and Pawter to take shelter in the Royale, which has been overrun with a gang of dangerous criminals. Meanwhile, Dutch and D'avin are trapped aboard Lucy, coming perilously close to the eye of the storm.

episodes.title: Enemy Khlyen
episodes.summary: The Killjoys finally turn the tables on Khlyen, only to discover the shocking truth behind his presence in The Quad, which leaves Dutch to wonder if she was ever truly free.

episodes.title: Escape Velocity
episodes.summary: Tensions boil over when the Company arrests a friend of the Killjoys, and peace on Westerley hangs by a thread. So when Khlyen kidnaps D'avin, Dutch and John are compelled to choose a side as tensions in The Quad reach critical mass.

episodes.title: Dutch and the Real Girl
episodes.summary: After failing to rescue D'avin from Arkyn, Dutch and Johnny head to Eulogy, an outlaw-only barter town, in the hopes of stealing a mysterious, high tech shield from the infamous Connaver gang.

episodes.title: Wild, Wild Westerley
episodes.summary: With D'avin back on the team, the Killjoys return to the ruins of Old Town to hunt eight escaped convicts but soon discover their most dangerous nemesis is the company fixer who issued the warrant.

episodes.title: Shaft
episodes.summary: As part of their secret investigation of the RAC, the Killjoys accept a ghost warrant to rescue three missing Killjoys lost in the heart of the Badlands. The mission leads them deep underground into an abandoned mine, where the bounty hunters become the hunted.

episodes.title: Schooled
episodes.summary: A simple escort mission takes a frightening turn when the Killjoys discover all the students have mysteriously disappeared from a school for gifted Westerley children.

episodes.title: Meet the Parents
episodes.summary: Johnny escorts Pawter home for a chilly family reunion while D'av experiences surprising side effects from Khlyen's Red 17 experiments.

episodes.title: I Love Lucy
episodes.summary: Dutch's search for the green plasma puts the team on the radar of an eccentric galactic collector.

episodes.title: Heart-Shaped Box
episodes.summary: The team are tested to the core as tensions rise while Dutch interrogates a lethal Level Six agent she captured and Johnny secretly investigates Jelco's wall for Pawter.

episodes.title: Full Metal Monk
episodes.summary: Clues from Khlyen's Red 17 transmission lead Dutch, D'avin, and Alvis to an old research facility on Arkyn, while Johnny and Pawter try to rally outside support in the impending war for Westerley.

episodes.title: Johnny Be Good
episodes.summary: Dutch and Johnny are at odds when Pawter's plans to free Old Town from Jelco's control results in Dutch being seized by an angry mob.

episodes.title: How to Kill Friends and Influence People
episodes.summary: The Killjoys and an old enemy join forces in a desperate bid to thwart Level Six's plans for The Quad.

episodes.title: Boondoggie
episodes.summary: As war looms over the J Star System, the Quad's surviving Hullen have gone into hiding, but Dutch and D'avin have a clever plan to draw them out. Far away on the fringes of the J Star System, Johnny begins a desperate hunt of his own for Clara, who is missing in the notorious Rat City. With few clues and less time, John goes deep undercover in the Hackmod world, chasing Clara's trail with an unlikely new ally.

episodes.title: A Skinner, Darkly
episodes.summary: Turin insists Dutch and D'avin take a few of the Rack's best brains for a test drive mission, in search for a temporary replacement for Johnny. The rookies soon find themselves over their heads, trapped in an abandoned black site bent on killing them all. Across the J, Johnny finds himself in hot water of his own as his search for Clara leads him to a mysterious skin rejuvenation centre, hiding an even bigger mystery under its surface.

episodes.title: The Hullen Have Eyes
episodes.summary: The Killjoys trace the last coordinates of a Black Root ship to a radiation scorched planet, finding an abandoned Hullen training camp, creepy inhabitants and a surprising connection to their past.

episodes.title: The Lion, the Witch & the Warlord
episodes.summary: An ambush sends Dutch and Johnny running to Pree's warlord past for help; D'avin tries to get to the bottom of a Black Warrant that hits unexpectedly close to home.

episodes.title: Attack the Rack
episodes.summary: The Killjoy rebels take drastic measures to clean house with a secret attack against the Rack.

episodes.title: Necropolis Now
episodes.summary: As Johnny faces off with someone from his past, Dutch faces her own personal hell.

episodes.title: The Wolf You Feed
episodes.summary: Desperate for an advantage, Dutch goes AWOL and risks a dangerous procedure that connects her to Aneela's memories.

episodes.title: Heist, Heist, Baby
episodes.summary: As the Killjoys plan a theft on an armored convoy, Aneela finds herself on a desperate search for Delle Seyah.

episodes.title: Reckoning Ball
episodes.summary: Johnny confronts his nemesis face to face when Delle Seyah suddenly arrives to set terms of war via parley.

episodes.title: Wargasm
episodes.summary: The Killjoy militia has everything they need to go to war, but as the battle begins, Aneela changes the entire game.

episodes.title: The Warrior Princess Bride
episodes.summary: Trapped in the mysterious and mind-bending greenspace and on the run from the deadly Lady, Aneela, and her father Khlyen struggle to stay one step ahead of the Lady, while keeping a wounded Dutch alive with a story that he promises will save her life: the tale of Dutch and Johnny's first mission in the Quad. He tells the story of the time when, down to their last few Joy, Dutch and John accepted a simple cargo transportation gig to the armpit of the galaxy and how this led to them facing off with a deadly assassin.

episodes.title: Johnny Dangerously
episodes.summary: With criminals chasing an injured Johnny, D'av and Delle Seyah take drastic measures to save him.

episodes.title: Bro-D Trip
episodes.summary: Johnny manipulates D'avin into helping him find a green pool while Zeph faces possible death.

episodes.title: What to Expect When You're Expecting … an Alien Parasite
episodes.summary: Dutch awakens to find Johnny at the brink of madness and the birth of D'avin's child.

episodes.title: Greening Pains
episodes.summary: With D'av's newborn son's life on the line, the trio take desperate measures to save him.

episodes.title: Baby, Face Killer
episodes.summary: Dutch trains Jaq to fight an unstoppable enemy as Pree and Fancy look for the missing Gared.

episodes.title: O Mother, Where Art Thou?
episodes.summary: With D'av and Jaq on the run, Dutch and John hunt the answer to Khlyen's memory clue.

episodes.title: It Takes a Pillage
episodes.summary: An awkward Jaqobis homecoming takes a deadly turn as Dutch and Zeph risk everything for science.

episodes.title: The Kids Are Alright?
episodes.summary: Team Awesome Force sneak onto the RAC to rescue Westerly's stolen children. Zeph and Pip grow closer.

episodes.title: Sporemageddon
episodes.summary: Aneela brings the Jaqobis brothers into Greenspace to defeat the Lady.

episodes.title: Run, Yala, Run
episodes.summary: Dutch realizes The Lady has put Westerley under a collective delusion and in a world without memory, nothing is what it seems.

episodes.title: Blame It on the Rain
episodes.summary: Awake from the memory matrix, Dutch is determined to wake her friends and stop the Lady, before it's too late.

episodes.title: Three Killjoys and a Lady
episodes.summary: The Killjoy trio begin to question if there is a traitor among their number after escaping from The Lady and rejoining Lucy outside the memory matrix.

episodes.title: Ship Outta Luck
episodes.summary: The Killjoy trio must figure out a way to breakout from an inescapable maximum security prison.

episodes.title: A Bout, A Girl
episodes.summary: Dutch enters the deadly Supermax prison fights for a chance to take over the entire ship.

episodes.title: Three Mutineers
episodes.summary: Dutch is caught off guard when she is confronted with a surprise hostage situation, and she must brainstorm over a new plan with D'avin and John.

episodes.title: Cherchez La Bitch
episodes.summary: The team embarks on an undercover mission and attempt to infiltrate a Leithian military base in the hope of tracking the Lady's real body.

episodes.title: Don't Stop Beweaving
episodes.summary: Dutch and Zeph embark on a sisterly road trip to a dangerous cult on Leith to find the key to The Lady's destruction.

episodes.title: Terraformance Anxiety
episodes.summary: The Lady's terraforming plans are becoming a reality, as the Killjoy trio scramble to find a way to defeat her.

episodes.title: Last Dance
episodes.summary: Dutch uses Khlyen to bait The Lady and finds herself in the midst of a final, epic showdown.
